title: Register as an ART provider
what: Register as an ART provider before providing ART services.

sources.title: Assisted Reproductive Technology Act 2024 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 21(1) (current republication (R5, from 16 December 2025; Assisted Reproductive Technology Act 2024 | Acts))
sources.quote: An ART provider commits an offence if it— (a) provides an ART service; and (b) is not a registered ART provider.
